subject: Post-demo: Context-length & token volume follow-up / pricing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: Context-length & token volume follow-up / pricing

Hi Sara 
- thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and next steps so we

What we heard:
- Primary use case: multi-document summarization + retrieval-augmented generation for customer support (100-200 queries/day initially, scaling).
- Expected average interaction: user prompt includes 1-3 documents plus a short user query.
- Initial model preference: open Llama-variant (you asked about 8k vs 32k support).

Open questions we promised to follow up on so we can size pricing: 
1) Typical avg prompt tokens (per request) - rough distribution (p50/p90)
2) Typical avg completion tokens (per request) and max expected completion length
3) Percent of requests that need extended context (8k / 32k / 128k)
4) Target unit economics - do you have a target $/1M tokens or a monthly budget range we should design toward?

Attached: context-length-profiling-template.csv (simple example you can fill) and a short pricing estimate template. If you can reply with ballpark numbers for the questions above, Jordan (cc'd) will use that to produce a 1M-token unit-cost target and a couple of pragmatic configuration suggestions (batching, caching, quantization) that meet your latency targets.

Proposed next steps:
- You: quick answers to Q1- Q4 (or attach a small sample export) - by Tue 3/17 if possible
- Jordan: follow up with cost scenarios and suggested model/context configuration - by Wed 3/18
- Schedule tech deep-dive (30m) if needed - please suggest availability

Thanks - happy to hop on a call to walk through the profiling template.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: context-length-profiling-template.csv, acme_pricing_estimate_v1.xlsx
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-16T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Context-length & token volume follow-up / pricing

Thanks Marissa - great summary, and appreciated the template. Answers below (ballpark):

Q1) Avg prompt tokens:
- p50: ~450 tokens (user query + retrieved snippets + metadata)
- p90: ~1,800 tokens (multi-doc / long threads)

Q2) Avg completion tokens:
- p50: ~120 tokens (concise answers)
- p90: ~800 tokens (detailed summaries / suggested replies)
- Max expected completion: 2,500 tokens (rare, for long-form summarization)

Q3) Extended context needs:
- ~65% of requests fit comfortably within 8k context
- ~30% would benefit from 32k (multiple long documents)
- ~5% might need 128k for large regulatory bundles / multi-article summaries

Q4) Budget / target unit economics:
- Current pilot budget: $6k-10k/month (proof-of-value)
- If unit economics look good, target $/1M tokens: ideally <= $250 for combined prompt+completion (upper bound $350).

We can also pull a small sample of actual traffic for Jordan to profile - I'll ask Tom to export ~1k recent requests and sanitize.

Thanks,
Sara
Head of Product
Acme AI
sara.jenkins@acme.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Context-length & token volume follow-up / pricing

Great - thanks for the numbers, Sara. A few quick clarifying questions so we size the 1M-token scenarios correctly:

1) For the p90 prompt tokens (1,800) - is that mostly long retrieved passages concatenated, or long user messages? If retrieved, what's the average number of retrieved docs and avg doc length (tokens)?
2) For the requests that need 32k/128k - are those single-request large bundles (one-shot summarization) or multi-turn that accumulate context?
3) Are you aiming for synchronous API latencies < 1s p50 for short answers, or is 2-3s tolerable? That affects batching decisions and model choices.

I'll start running the pricing scenarios with three buckets:
- conservative (all tokens priced at baseline model + 20% infra premium)
- optimized (batching, cache hit assumptions, quantized model variant)
- premium (low-latency single-replica, higher per-token)

I'll attach an initial cost table and a recommended config per bucket. If Tom can share the 1k-sample export, I'll run the context-length profile and return a recommended mix for 8k/32k/128k allocations.

-Jordan
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com

Perfect - thanks Tom and Sara. Jordan and I will run the profiling and deliver:
- A context-length breakdown (p50/p90 input & output tokens) from the sample
